firstPlayerRule: The person most afraid of water starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Everyone first chooses a paddle card simultaneously. The starting player reveals theirs first, followed by the others clockwise.
The lifesaver marks the starter and passes to the left at the end of each round.
interpretation: The English manual describes the starter as the most hydrophobic player; the short answer restates that in everyday language.
